notes: Fixed the game declaring a winner after the very first move, piece-count and point-count domination rules not taking effect, quick-finish leaving defeated pieces on the board with replay positions off, the position rating chart drawing only half the game, and history records being lost; AI evaluation gained lightweight points and piece-count options, and the best move now appears inside the player ranking card; the hint button is hidden during AI turns and the board no longer jumps when status text appears
notes_zh: 修复开局第一子落地就判胜负、碾压规则不生效、一键终局残留输家棋子与回放错位、评分曲线只画一半、历史记录丢失；AI 评估新增点数与棋子数两种轻量选项，最佳一步并入排名卡；轮 AI 时隐藏建议按钮，修复提示文字导致棋盘上下跳动
